fix-auth-bug.auth.mjs: export function canRefresh(token, nowMs) { return !!token && !token.revoked && Number.isFinite(token.expiresAt) && Number.isFinite(nowMs) && token.expiresAt * 1000 > nowMs; }

add-api-endpoint.app.mjs: export function handle(request) { const url = new URL(request.url); if (url.pathname === '/health' && request.method === 'GET') return Response.json({ok:true}); if (url.pathname !== '/api/sum') return Response.json({error:'Not found'}, {status:404}); if(request.method !== 'GET') return Response.json({error:'Method'}, {status:405}); const a=url.searchParams.get('a'), b=url.searchParams.get('b'); if(a===null || b===null || !a.trim() || !b.trim() || !Number.isFinite(Number(a)) || !Number.isFinite(Number(b)) || !Number.isFinite(Number(a)+Number(b))) return Response.json({error:'Invalid'}, {status:400}); return Response.json({sum:Number(a)+Number(b)}); }

multi-file-feature.store.mjs: const tasks=[]; let nextId=1; export function create(title) { const task={id:String(nextId++),title,completed:false}; tasks.push(task); return task; } export function list() { return tasks; } export function setCompleted(id,completed) { const task=tasks.find(item=>item.id===id); if(!task) return null; task.completed=completed; return task; }
multi-file-feature.routes.mjs: import {create,list,setCompleted} from './store.mjs'; import {serialize} from './serialize.mjs'; export async function handle(request) { const path=new URL(request.url).pathname; if(path==='/tasks' && request.method==='GET') return Response.json(list().map(serialize)); if(path==='/tasks' && request.method==='POST') { const {title}=await request.json(); return Response.json(serialize(create(title)),{status:201}); } if(path.startsWith('/tasks/') && request.method==='PATCH') { let data; try { data=await request.json(); } catch { return Response.json({error:'Invalid'}, {status:400}); } if(typeof data?.completed!=='boolean') return Response.json({error:'Invalid'}, {status:400}); const task=setCompleted(path.slice(7),data.completed); return task?Response.json(serialize(task)):Response.json({error:'Not found'}, {status:404}); } return Response.json({error:'Not found'}, {status:404}); }
